At /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/, I need the EXACT navbar HTML and CSS.

1. From index.html, extract the COMPLETE navbar HTML — from the opening `<section class="header-sec">` through the closing `</section>` of the header. Include EVERY element: logo, nav links, dropdowns, mobile hamburger, CTA buttons.

2. From css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css, search and extract EVERY CSS rule for these classes (include ALL responsive breakpoints):
   - .header-sec, .banner-section
   - .navbar, .w-nav
   - .nav-23-logo, .nav-logo-text
   - .nav-23-link, .menu-text
   - .nav-23-dropdown, .nav-23-dropdown-toggle, .nav-23-dropdown-list, .nav-23-dropdown-card
   - .nav-dropdown-link-2, .nav-dropdown-icon, .nav-head, .nav-para
   - .mnav-inn (custom solution link at bottom of solutions dropdown)
   - .nav-23-right, .button-secondary-large, .btn-primary
   - .nav-23-menu-button, .nav-23-menu-burger, .nav-23-menu-line
   - .header-comingsoon-badge
   - .w-nav-overlay, .w-nav-button
   - ALL sticky navbar CSS from the custom code (the .navbar.w-nav.sticky class)

3. Also extract the mobile nav overlay HTML structure — what happens when hamburger is clicked on mobile

Be EXHAUSTIVE — every CSS property matters for pixel-perfect matching.
